description: This file contains unit tests for the iscc_sdk module, testing utility functions such as TempFile, timer, and is_installed, using mocking and assertions.

methods.name: test_tempfile
methods.description: Tests the TempFile context manager for existence and cleanup.

methods.name: test_timer_measures_time
methods.description: Verifies that the timer correctly measures elapsed time using mock perf_counter.

methods.name: test_timer_logs_message
methods.description: Checks that the timer logs the correct message with elapsed time.

methods.name: test_timer_with_exception
methods.description: Ensures the timer logs timing even if an exception occurs within the context.

methods.name: test_timer_real_timing
methods.description: Performs a real sleep to test the timer's measurement of actual elapsed time.

methods.name: test_is_installed_true
methods.description: Tests that iscc_sdk.is_installed returns True for an installed package.

methods.name: test_is_installed_false
methods.description: Tests that iscc_sdk.is_installed returns False for a non-existent package.
